gaps: The roadmap's prior MDL-1 scope required the broader model-management UX while this plan addresses live provider discovery.
A live provider omission could be mistaken for deletion or deprecation and cause destructive cleanup.
Automatic registration would require Gantry to guess aliases, workloads, and capabilities that provider listings do not reliably supply.
A second durable provider-model inventory would conflict with settings-owned model aliases.
resolutions: Committed roadmap change 4cdf25c25 narrows MDL-1 to the client-approved discovery and registration feature and explicitly re-scopes the broader UX program.
The plan makes provider listings observational only, retains every saved alias, labels omission as configured_not_advertised, and forbids inferred deprecation.
The plan requires explicit registration through the existing model_aliases parser and settings revision path; raw discovered IDs remain unselectable.
The plan rejects a new inventory table and keeps model_aliases as durable authority, adding only immutable run identity snapshots.
summary: The smallest complete design reuses provider routing, credential resolution, model aliases, and settings revisions. Live listings remain bounded, cached observations and never become deletion authority.
